scope: Proposition 8.1 (Adjacent bridges and polygon shapes) of the manuscript “Disk transfer representations and confined bridge mass” (preprints/Disk-transfer-representations-and-confined-bridge-mass-September-26-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 237 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 d64dc634fe49d994), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 56. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For an admissible strip of height R, let F(R) = f1,1 be the critical mass of pairs of vertex-disjoint bridges with adjacent endpoints on each wall, fixing the first bottom port and summing the first top port. For a full-plane simple polygon γ, let [γ] denote its unrooted, unoriented translation class under the lattice generated by U, V . There is an absolute constant C such that F(R) ≤ CR−3 , ∑ [γ] L≤diam γ<2L x|γ| ≤ CL−2 (L ≥ 1).
